body.message:
As per your request, please find the rate details for 76 nights at Upside Living – Burj View, Studio below:

Stay Period: 16th September to 1st December
Total Duration: 76 nights
Total Rate: AED 21,600

Please note the following:

A refundable security deposit of AED 2,000 is required.
The booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.
The refundable security deposit will be reimbursed within 14 working days after check-out, subject to a satisfactory inspection of the property.
The deposit can be refunded via the original credit card or bank transfer.

Please let us know if you would like to proceed with the booking.

Thank you.
